policy.title: Listing Policy
policy.intro: Minstrel is a dedicated portal collecting and publishing information about game music concerts held in Japan. Our goal is not to list every concert, but to accurately deliver information focused on game music.
policy.definitionBody: Minstrel lists concerts that perform music originally composed for video games — including game soundtracks and music created specifically for games.
includedItems: Concerts performing music from Final Fantasy, The Legend of Zelda, Dragon Quest, and other game series
Orchestra or wind ensemble concerts themed around game soundtracks
excludedItems: Concerts performing only music from anime, manga, or film IPs (even if those IPs later received game adaptations)
Concerts featuring only anime songs, J-POP, or other non-game music
policy.mixedNote: For concerts mixing game music with other genres, we evaluate the program content on a case-by-case basis.
policy.collectionBody1: Concert information is automatically collected from official ticket sites, organizer websites, and official social media accounts. All listings go through a mechanical validation process, but we cannot guarantee complete accuracy.
policy.collectionBody2: Always check each concert's official sources for the latest information on schedules, tickets, and cancellations.
policy.removalBody: If you find incorrect information, or if you are a rights holder or organizer requesting removal, we will respond promptly. Please contact us via the Contact page.

submit.title: Submit a Concert
submit.subtitle: Submit concerts that aren't listed on major ticket sites — such as student ensembles or self-produced events.
submit.note: Submissions are reviewed by our staff and will only be listed if they meet our listing criteria. Listing is not guaranteed.
